regime_context: The US thematic tape is a narrow AI-infrastructure-led regime: AI Infrastructure leads with a 1.56 score, breadth is thin (0.125) and the headline itself is 'mixed' Hurst — leadership is real but not broad. Energy is the challenger with much better breadth (0.636); rotation is narrowing (22/49 eligible) and NOT one-narrative, with unscheduled macro surprise elevated at 0.75. The only validated leg here is absolute-trend gating for drawdown control (gate_helps true), so leans are trend-discipline framing, not return calls.
emerging_watch: Watching whether US Energy Complex (score 1.375, breadth 0.636, crowding_z 0.93 and rising) can produce a confirmed handoff ahead of AI Infrastructure — the margin is only 0.185. The watch condition that retires this: Energy's score eclipses AI Infrastructure AND Energy breadth simultaneously expands with absorption rising — until then this is just a challenger, not leadership.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: The detector's eligibility + rank leg keeps AI Infrastructure as the prevailing focus theme (eligible, score 1.56, top of ranks), but its 0.125 breadth and 'mixed' Hurst tag mean leadership is concentrated and trend health is not clean. A lean here is a continuity-of-leadership view, not an alpha claim: only worth expressing while the absolute-trend gate holds and before any confirmed handoff.
evidence: rotation.leader is ai_infra with margin 0.185 over energy
theses.dissent: Narrow breadth plus mixed trend health means the theme is one or two names moving the proxy; any idiosyncratic stumble guts the theme without a broad base to absorb it.

falsifier.text: SMH closes below its 10-week moving average and the theme's own breadth drops to 0 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity screens as the classic reflexive crowding caution: top-three rank and strong trend tag, but crowding_z 1.61 with crowded=true. The guardrail forbids fading on crowding and forbids treating crowding as a sell — but it also says cap, don't chase. An 'avoid' lean (no fresh entry, no fade) is the correct expression of a crowded high-momentum theme with no validated entry edge.
theses.dissent: The counter-case is that the trend tag is genuinely clean (hurst 'trend', durability 0.75) and the crowd can stay right longer than a timing signal would suggest — avoiding is not a bet it falls.

falsifier.text: CIBR makes a new 20-day high on above-average volume while broadening participation (no confirmation of crowding damage) before the check-by date

theses.subject: Managed Care & Insurers
theses.thesis: This is the one high-durability (0.81) but crowded (1.11) theme deep enough in negative score territory (-0.08) that the trend-gate lens tilts bearish on continuation. It is eligible, so it passes the absolute-trend filter, but the combination of negative rank momentum and flag-level crowding argues for a size-down/underweight posture rather than participation.
theses.dissent: That 0.81 durability is the best on the board and breadth is 0.778 — this looks like a quiet, sustained defensive grind where a negative momentum score may just be noise against a strong base.

falsifier.text: XLV closes back above its prior 60-day high with Managed Care leadership reasserting before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
